newsitem.title: POLAND: KGHM expects no ill-effects from flooding.
newsitem.headline: KGHM expects no ill-effects from flooding.

text.p: Poland's KGHM Polska Miedz SA said its copper mines and smelters in the Legnica province will not be affected when the flood wave on the Odra river passes through the province.
Output will be kept at normal levels, the company said in a statement.
"During the flooding around Legnica, KGHM Polska Miedz SA will keep copper production at the planned level," it said.
It said the flood wave reached the Legnica province earlier on Monday.
"The flood wave proceeding through the Legnica province does not endanger KGHM Polska Miedz's mines and mills," the statement said.
It also said local water supplies have been secured and an alternative water supply has been prepared.

The Warsaw bourse has so far suspended trade in seven listed industrial firms operating in the south of Poland which have been either hit by the flooding or proved unable to submit timely information on their condition.
The week-old disaster has covered 3,600 square kilometres at its peak and claimed so far 36 lives. @
